biography: Dr Akbar Husnoo is a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence researcher, educator, and technology professional with expertise spanning AI, data science, cyber resilience, and responsible technology. He holds a PhD in Cybersecurity from Deakin University, where his research focused on AI-driven intrusion detection and resilient critical infrastructure. His experience extends across academia, local government, and industry, with a strong focus on translating emerging technologies into practical, responsible outcomes.
